_comment: Local corrections applied ON TOP OF default-model-prices.json.
default-model-prices.json is synced verbatim from Langfuse upstream, so a wrong
value there cannot be fixed by editing it -- the next `pnpm run sync-prices`
would silently revert the edit and quietly restore the mispricing. Overrides
live here instead and are re-applied by scripts/generate.mjs on every generate.
- Verify against the PROVIDER's own pricing page, not a third party.
- Record the source URL and the date you checked it.
- Quote the provider's figure verbatim in `providerQuote`.
- Override only the keys you actually verified. Do not 'fix' neighbours by
inference -- of the four Gemini 2.5 cached-input prices in the catalog,
three were already correct and only one was wrong.
generate.mjs fails loudly if an override targets a model, tier, or price key
that no longer exists, so upstream fixing a value shows up as a build error
asking you to drop the override rather than as a silent no-op.

overrides.reason: Upstream carried $0.025/1M for cached input tokens; Google publishes $0.01/1M. 2.5x overcharge on every cached Flash-Lite token.
notes: Checked the sibling models at the same time; all were already correct and are
deliberately NOT overridden: gemini-2.5-flash cached $0.03/1M, gemini-2.5-pro
NOT modelled here: Google also charges context-cache STORAGE at $1.00 per 1M
tokens per hour for explicit caching (CachedContent API). Implicit caching has
